# IndexProjectGraph

## Rules

- `IndexProjectGraph.execute(input)` builds `IndexOptions` from `projectRoot`, `workspaces`, optional `configuredWorkspaces`, `graphConfig` (per-file size limit + size-exempt patterns kept separate project vs workspace; resolved into effective values by indexer), `codeGraphVersion`, `vcsRoot`, optional `vcsRef`, `onProgress`, `onEvent`, `force`; calls `provider.index()`; returns `IndexResult` unchanged.
- Effective size limit resolution (single place, including no-`specd.yaml` bootstrap): per workspace `maxFileBytes` = workspace else project else built-in default `262144` (`0` = no limit); `largeFilePaths` = project patterns ∪ workspace patterns each with base directory. Resolved values part of graph fingerprint inputs. No other call site applies default.
- `force` requests complete logical reindex: clear reusable indexed contents, bypass incremental reuse so every selected input reconsidered. MUST NOT call `CodeGraphProvider.recreate()` or implement physical-storage recovery; provider already open; recoverable open failures handled by SDK lifecycle owner.
- Input: already-open `provider` + prepared project values. Forward `vcsRoot` and `configuredWorkspaces` unchanged. MUST NOT resolve workspaces, lock, spawn, open, close, directly clear, recreate, or own storage lifecycle. Only force responsibility: forward force intent.
- `createIndexProjectGraph()` returns stateless `IndexProjectGraph`.

## Constraints

- No provider open/close or index-lock acquisition/release.
- Per-file parse failures remain `IndexResult.errors`; use case MUST NOT throw them.
